pl_ajustes_bluetooth_ayuda: Open Settings on your phone and go to Bluetooth.
pl_ajustes_permisos_ayuda: Open Settings on your phone and grant permissions to {{app}}.
pl_aviso_sin_bluetooth: This app has no access to Bluetooth (opened with Expo Go?). You can browse, but not connect to the locker; use the development build for that.
pl_bt_apagado_inicio_mensaje: {{app}} needs Bluetooth to be on. Do you want the app to turn it on, or would you rather do it from the phone settings?
pl_bt_apagado_mensaje: Please turn Bluetooth on to look for your {{app}}.
pl_bt_no_disponible_mensaje: This app has no access to Bluetooth. If you opened it with Expo Go, install the development build; otherwise your phone does not support it.
pl_buscar_ayuda: These are the Bluetooth devices we have found around you. Select your {{app}} from the list to pair it with this app.
pl_detectado_mensaje: We found “{{dispositivo}}”. If you pair it, the app will connect to it over Bluetooth and you will be able to manage your access from this phone.
pl_error_emparejar: The device could not be paired.
pl_error_mensaje: We are sorry. {{app}} has encountered a problem and cannot continue. You may review the error log and provide it to the developer.
pl_error_permisos_sistema: A Bluetooth permission is missing in the system. Please open the app settings and grant the Bluetooth and {{permiso}} permissions.
pl_no_aparece_mensaje: Check that it is on and nearby, and that Bluetooth and permissions are enabled.
pl_nombre_ayuda: Enter your name or nickname to identify yourself in your {{app}}.
pl_permisos_mensaje: {{app}} needs Bluetooth and Location permissions to detect and connect automatically to your smart lock.
pl_pin_incorrecto_error: The PIN you entered is not correct.
pl_sin_dispositivo_mensaje: Look for your {{app}} to pair it and be able to open your door or garage.
pl_vinculacion_error_generico: Pairing error: it could not be completed. Please try again.
pl_vinculacion_error_mac: Pairing error: this device does not match your {{app}}.
pl_vinculando_ayuda: Pairing... If your phone asks for the Bluetooth PIN in a notification, enter it.
pl_vinculando_ayuda_simulacion: Pairing... If your phone asks for the Bluetooth PIN in a notification, enter {{pin}}.
pl_vincular_pin_mensaje: Enter the security PIN to pair this {{app}}.
pl_vincular_pin_mensaje_simulacion: Enter the security PIN ({{pin}}) to pair this {{app}}.
